coverage.description: Validate arity and variable, evaluate lo then hi, check span, save the current binding. Each inclusive iteration ticks, binds k, evaluates body, updates the selected accumulator or early-exits. Normal loop exit restores saved binding before result extraction and capped note. Any ? before restoration retains reached prefix state.
